the i.p. model of primary tuberculosis in mice is useful for studying the pathogenesis and the host immune response to M. tuberculosis, but it is not suitable for testing new anti‐tuberculosis drugs.

the i.p. route of infection can be used to study slowly progressive primary tuberculosis in mice.

the i.p. route is a good route to study primary tuberculosis in mice.
slowly progressive primary TB can be induced in mice by i.p. infection with 1.2‐1.5 log CFU of virulent M. tuberculosis.
